summary: Wallowa-Whitman NF lookout near Anthony Lakes, Oregon: a 20-foot pole L-4 tower built 1935, replaced 1942, removed or destroyed in 1968.

facts.design: 20-foot pole L-4 tower (1935), replaced in 1942 by what the register calls a 10-foot Supervisor Hall live-in tower
facts.status_note: Register and Rex's page say the tower was removed in 1968; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1968

staffing.status: a planned summer posting in 1934; summer staff named 1938 through 1940; no end-of-staffing date in these sources

events.note: Register and firelookout.com date the 20-foot pole L-4 tower to 1935; a 1933 item had announced a house on a 20-foot tower and a 1934 item called the station new
July 1934 Record-Courier item says Harry Craig would be stationed there that summer (planned posting)
Raymond Pederson in charge of the station, per a 1938 La Grande Observer item
Bernal Coles of Haines at Chicken Hill in August 1939, when fire hazard led to a doubling of station forces at various lookouts
A Wolf Creek schoolteacher and her husband went to the station for the 1940 summer months
Register says the 20-foot pole tower was replaced with a 10-foot Supervisor Hall live-in tower
Register and Rex's page say removed in 1968; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1968
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register June 13, 2011

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A September 1933 item said a house would be built on a 20-foot tower and a July 1934 item called the station new. The register and firelookout.com both give 1935 as the build year, so the story uses 1935 and notes the earlier items.
The register and Rex's page say removed in 1968; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1968. All three agree on 1968; they differ only on the manner of ending.

sources.title: Chicken Hill

notes_for_editor: No source describes what remains on the site today, and none gives public access or a visiting rule, so access is omitted. The brief's height_m of 6.1 matches the original 20-foot tower; the 1942 replacement is described only as a 10-foot Supervisor Hall live-in tower, with no height given. The brief's record has no build year; 1935 is added from the register and firelookout.com. Staffing items are from a 1933-1940 Record-Courier and La Grande Observer run as quoted on Rex's page, not from the original newspapers. The register has a photo captioned 'Chicken Hill Lookout 1942' (Ron Kemnow collection) but no image URL was pulled, so no photos were added. The 2008 Chicken Hill Fire near Anthony Lakes is named for the road and area, not the lookout, and is excluded.
